Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 6893 (Part 5) - 1987 



Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

PROFORMA FOR PURCHASE SPECIFICATION FOR 
MACHINE TOOLS 

PART 5 MILLING MACHINE WITH TABLE OF VARIABLE HEIGHT 
WITH VERTICAL SPINDLE 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope — Lays down the proforma for the preparation of purchase specifications for milling 
machines with table of variable height with vertical spindle. It also gives essentia! information about 
the vertical milling machines and their accessories which will enable the user to assess their usefulness 
and applicability.

chart for vertical milling machines ) :

1) Column 

2) Table 

b) Any other special feature.

IS : 6893 (Part 5) -1987 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The proforma for purchase specification for machine tools has been prepared to enable a 
prospective buyer to collect data from various manufacturers/suppliers for purposes of comparison. 
This proforma is meant to be sent out with an enquiry by the purchaser so that the manufacturers/ 
suppliers can fill in the data and send it back to the purchaser to make comparison easier for the 
purchaser. 

Reference is made to the following Indian Standards in this standard: 

IS : 5-1978 Colours for ready mixed paints ( second revision ) 

IS : 2013-1985 Dimensions for T-slots {second revision ) 

IS : 2161-1962 Specifications for coolant pumps for machine tools 

IS : 2201 -1973 Test chart for milling machine with table of variable height with vertical spindle 
{first revision) 

IS : 2642-1985 Spacing of T-slots { second revision ) 

IS : 4691-1985 Degrees of protection provided by enclosing for rotating electrical machinery 

IS : 4729-1968 Measurement and evaluation of vibration of rotating electrical machine 

IS : 6681 -1972 Dimensions for self-release 7/24 tapers for spindle noses for milling machines 

IS : 9474-1980 Principles of mechanical guarding of machinery 

IS : 10988-1984 Method of measurement of noise from machine tools (excluding testing in 
anochoic chambers ) 

This standard was first published in 1975. The Committee responsible for the formulation of this 
standard decided to revise the- same based upon experience gained. 

in the present revision, detailed requirements of motors, coolant pumps, and requirement for 
environmental and safety aspects have also been included in the proforma. 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
